title: AI financing driving private credit growth as refinancing risks rise, Moody’s says
reason: 穆迪指出AI基础设施借贷正把私募信贷推出传统企业放贷范围，同时未来几年到期再融资风险上升，是债务与资金流的结构性风险信号。
summary: High levels of borrowing to fund AI infrastructure is expanding private credit beyond traditional corporate ​lending, but a wave of loans coming ‌due in the next few years could leave weaker borrowers ...

paragraphs.text: Jumpstart your morning with the latest legal news delivered straight to your inbox from The Daily Docket newsletter. Sign up here.
The ratings agency said AI financing needs now extend ​beyond data-center construction to land, power, semiconductors, ⁠graphics processing units and tensor processing units

Moody's expects capital ​spending by the five largest US hyperscalers and ​CoreWeave (CRWV.O), opens new tab to reach nearly $1 trillion in 2027, financed through cash flows, debt and structures such as joint ventures and special-purpose ​vehicles
However, a wave of loans coming due between ​2027 and 2029 will test weaker borrowers’ ability to refinance ‌at ⁠higher interest rates, Moody’s said
About 17% of the 607 borrowers tracked by Moody’s used payment-in-kind interest, which allows companies to defer cash interest payments but ​adds to ​their debt ⁠burden
A Reuters analysis earlier this year found loan maturities at US business development ​companies would peak in 2028 and 2029
Recent ​stress in ⁠CoreWeave debt has also highlighted investors’ growing concerns about highly leveraged AI borrowers

Moody's also flagged "circular" financing risks as ⁠technology ​companies, chipmakers and AI developers increasingly ​invest in, lend to and buy from one another, raising fears ​that correlated exposures could weaken together during a downturn
Reporting by Pragyan Kalita in Bengaluru
Our Standards: The Thomson Reuters Trust Principles., opens new tab

annotations.explanation: extend 后接 beyond 表示范围不再局限于某事物，常用于描述需求、影响扩大。

examples.en: The risks extend beyond the banking sector.

annotations.explanation: 常用复数，指芯片及芯片产业。

examples.en: Demand for semiconductors surged last year.

annotations.explanation: 企业用于设备、厂房等长期资产的投入，财报常用词。

examples.en: Capital spending fell for the second quarter.
examples.zh: 资本支出连续第二个季度下降。

annotations.explanation: 指亚马逊、微软、谷歌等运营超大规模数据中心的公司。

examples.zh: 超大规模云厂商正在采购更多芯片。

annotations.explanation: 与 vehicle 连用即 SPV（特殊目的实体），为特定融资设立、可隔离风险的公司。

examples.en: The bonds were issued through a special-purpose entity.
examples.zh: 债券通过特殊目的实体发行。

annotations.explanation: 债务、账单“到期应付”，due 表示应在某时间偿还。

examples.en: Several loans come due next spring.
examples.zh: 几笔贷款明年春天到期。

target.text: test weaker borrowers’ ability to refinance

annotations.meaningZh: 考验较弱借款人的再融资能力
annotations.lemma: test someone’s ability to do something
annotations.explanation: test 此处是动词“考验”，而非“测试”。

examples.en: The crisis will test the firm’s ability to survive.
examples.zh: 这场危机将考验公司的生存能力。

annotations.explanation: 用新债偿还旧债，通常为延期或降低利率。

examples.en: They refinanced the mortgage at a lower rate.
examples.zh: 他们以更低利率对抵押贷款再融资。

annotations.explanation: 利息不付现金，而是计入本金，债务越滚越大。

examples.en: PIK interest keeps cash in the company but raises debt.
examples.zh: PIK利息保住了现金，却增加了债务。

annotations.explanation: defer 指推迟；与 postpone 相比更正式，金融语境常见。

examples.en: The lender agreed to defer payments for a year.
examples.zh: 贷方同意将还款推迟一年。

annotations.explanation: burden 本义“重担”，debt burden 是常见搭配。

examples.en: A heavy debt burden limits growth.
examples.zh: 沉重的债务负担限制增长。

annotations.explanation: 美国一类向中小企业放贷的上市投资实体，是私募信贷的重要参与者。
peak 作动词表示“达到顶峰”。
leverage 指借债经营；highly leveraged 表示负债占比很高。

examples.en: The highly leveraged firm struggled when rates rose.
examples.zh: 这家高杠杆公司在利率上升时陷入困境。

annotations.explanation: 金融里 stress 指市场或资产出现压力，如价格下跌、利差扩大。

examples.en: There is stress in the credit market.

annotations.explanation: 公司之间互相投资、借贷又互相采购，资金在圈内打转，可能放大风险。

examples.en: Critics warn of circular financing in AI.
examples.zh: 批评者警告AI领域存在循环融资。

annotations.explanation: 多个资产同涨同跌的风险暴露，意味着分散化失效。

examples.zh: 相关性敞口会放大损失。

annotations.explanation: 经济或市场下滑阶段，反义 upturn。
